newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Telcel to install public cellular phones. [corrected 20:52 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Telcel to install public cellular phones. [corrected 20:52 gmt]

text.p: Venezuelan cellular telephone company Telcel, which competes directly with CANTV cell phone subsidiary Movilnet, said it would invest $1 million (corrects from $100 million) next year in public cellular telehopnes.
The public phones will be installed "in places inaccessible, either partially or totally, to the current phone cable network," Telcel said in a press statement.
Over 130 public phones will be installed through 1997, half of which will be in Caracas, the company added.
